description: This file defines a Java interface for User repository using Spring Data JPA, providing methods to find users by username and check existence by username.

classes.name: UserRepository
classes.description: Spring Data JPA repository interface for User entity, providing custom query methods.

methods.name: findByUsername
methods.description: Retrieves an Optional containing User if a user with the given username exists.

methods.name: existsByUsername
methods.description: Checks whether a user with the specified username exists.
